description: List regular member pathnames in archive order through the retained ZIP input binding.

interface.semantic_input: A path to a readable ZIP archive on the tested filesystem.
interface.semantic_output: Ordered names of regular members. Names and multiplicity are preserved on the tested archive fixtures.

resources: Collects names in memory. Bounds on member count, name length and total processing cost are unknown.

preconditions.detail: The row advertises ZIP input and no parameters. The underlying callable relies on libarchive content detection.

refinements.detail: A valid TAR input supplied to the ZIP binding also succeeded. Enumeration therefore does not establish that the file is a ZIP archive.

postconditions.detail: Returned only regular-file pathnames, including nested paths, zero-length members and repeated names, in archive order on the frozen ZIPs.

effects.detail: The reader enumerated member names. Missing and unrecognized archive inputs raised runtime_error. Each failed ordinary program retained an existing destination or left an absent destination absent.

invariants.detail: Directory and symlink entries did not appear in the regular-file list. A zero-entry ZIP produced an empty array.

formal_predicates.detail: Enumeration alone does not establish format conformance, member-content integrity, or a universal file-type guarantee.

mathematical_properties.detail: No general ordering or filtering property was proved.

state_protocol.detail: Allocates a libarchive reader, visits headers and closes it synchronously.

ownership.detail: Borrows the input path, manages the reader with a unique pointer, and returns owned strings.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent reads and concurrent changes to the source file were not tested.

upstream_usage.detail: The project declares archive_files for TAR and registers a ZIP alias for that callable. The historical example exercises the TAR binding.

specification_question.detail: The caller supplies the input path and MIME type. There is no configurable archive member filter in this row.
